title: Balance
subtitle: Payments and work time are kept separate.
editWindow: Your own entries can be corrected or deleted for five days.
effortHint: Optional: money and work time are recorded separately.
otherMembersHint: When disabled, effort is always assigned to the recording person.
settingHint: Controls whether another member can be selected when recording a payment or work time.
onlyAdmin: Only the household creator can change this balance setting.
requiredPurpose: Please state what the effort was for.
separateHint: The balance keeps money and work time separate.
multipleEffortsHint: You can add several payments and work times for different people.
requiredEffort: Please add at least one complete balance effort.
settlementDescription: Payments are split evenly among active household members. This is only a suggestion – nothing is recorded or transferred.
settlementNotEnoughMembers: At least two active members are needed for a settlement.
settlementNoPayments: No payments have been recorded yet. Work time is deliberately not converted into euros.
settlementAlreadyBalanced: The recorded payments are already balanced.
